refundPaidAndRefunded.es: El pasajero pagó {paid}; ya se le devolvieron {refunded}.
refundPaidAndRefunded.en: The passenger paid {paid}; {refunded} was already refunded.
refundPaidAndRefunded.pt: O passageiro pagou {paid}; já foram devolvidos {refunded}.

refundMethodInvoiceCredit.es: Crédito en la factura de la empresa

refundReasonHint.es: Ej.: el chófer llegó 25 min tarde
refundReasonHint.en: E.g. the chauffeur was 25 min late
refundReasonHint.pt: Ex.: o motorista chegou 25 min atrasado

refundNote.es: La devolución la haces tú por fuera de la app; aquí queda registrada, el pasajero recibe un aviso y su recibo la muestra. No cambia la liquidación del chófer: el costo es de Luxelane.
refundNote.en: You pay the money back outside the app; here it is recorded, the passenger is notified and their receipt shows it. It doesn't change the chauffeur's settlement: Luxelane bears the cost.
refundNote.pt: Você faz a devolução fora do app; aqui ela fica registrada, o passageiro recebe um aviso e o recibo a mostra. Não muda o acerto do motorista: o custo é da Luxelane.

refundRecorded.en: Refund recorded. The passenger was notified.

refundErrorAmount.es: Ingresa un monto mayor a 0 (hasta 2 decimales).
refundErrorAmount.en: Enter an amount above 0 (up to 2 decimals).
refundErrorAmount.pt: Informe um valor maior que 0 (até 2 casas decimais).

refundErrorTooMuch.es: El monto supera lo que queda por devolver.
refundErrorTooMuch.en: The amount is more than what's left to refund.
refundErrorTooMuch.pt: O valor é maior que o que resta devolver.

refundErrorNotCompleted.en: Only completed rides can be refunded.
refundErrorNotCompleted.pt: Só viagens concluídas podem ser reembolsadas.

refundErrorCard.es: Los pagos con tarjeta se reembolsan por Stripe, no se registran aquí.
refundErrorCard.en: Card payments are refunded through Stripe, not recorded here.
refundErrorCard.pt: Pagamentos com cartão são reembolsados pelo Stripe, não registrados aqui.
